summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K disclosing periodic share buy-back transactions under the second tranche of its 2026 buy-back programme. From June 1–5, 2026, the company purchased 408,516 own shares at an average price of NOK 350.57 per share, bringing total repurchases for the tranche to 1,054,276 shares (approximately $143M aggregate value). The buy-back was announced on May 6, 2026, and runs from May 19 to no later than July 20, 2026. This is a routine open-market repurchase program, not a self-tender offer, structural restructuring, or other special situation. The filing is a routine disclosure obligation under EU Market Abuse Regulation; no extraordinary board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics are involved.
